name: marker 转换串联腿 PDF 第四次
command:
cd "/home/nesc/Documents/revo-repo/01 RAW" && export LLAMA_CPP_BINARY="$HOME/.local/llama.cpp/llama-b10991/llama-server" && /tmp/marker-env/bin/python -c "
from marker.converters.pdf import PdfConverter
from marker.models import create_model_dict
from marker.output import text_from_rendered
converter = PdfConverter(artifact_dict=create_model_dict())
rendered = converter('串联腿机器人建模与控制开源文档.pdf')
text, _, images = text_from_rendered(rendered)
open('/tmp/leg_marker.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write(text)
import pathlib
pathlib.Path('/tmp/leg_marker_images').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for k,v in images.items():
    data = v.getvalue() if hasattr(v,'getvalue') else v
    pathlib.Path('/tmp/leg_marker_images', k).write_bytes(data)
print('DONE', len(text), len(images))
"
